$comment: Known-answer EMI cases from published Indian examples, found via web search on 2026-09-29. The search tool returned a summary quote plus the pages it drew on, so `sources` lists those candidate pages; which page carries each exact figure is NOT confirmed (direct page fetch was blocked in the build environment). Every case was independently recomputed (Python float64) and matches to the rupee. Before launch the Verifier or owner should open the pages and trim each list to the page that shows the figure. Totals are listed only where the source derives them from the unrounded EMI (our convention).
